decisions.reason: Changing each variant's exposure title does not alter its report-detail identifier; the report-code corrections in the same message are separate direct decisions already represented.
The exposure-title mapping does not change footer report codes; the same-message footer-code corrections are separate and already represented.
The exposure-title mapping does not change internal-header report codes; the same-message header-code corrections are separate and already represented.
The dashboard displays an exposure level across all variants, but the source describes variant titles without establishing whether those titles are the dashboard's exposure-level values.
The corrected exposure titles do not necessarily change the RR01-specific page-two wording or storage-assessment copy.
Correcting variant exposure titles leaves the general visual-quality standard and cross-variant design consistency requirement unchanged.
The variant exposure-title mapping does not change the required format, detail level, or content categories of the result explanation.
Correcting fixed exposure titles by report variant does not change which customer-specific fields must remain editable or the assessment-date behavior.
The exposure-title mapping does not alter internal-header coverage, style, or required information.
The exposure-title mapping does not alter footer style, page coverage, or required footer information.
Changing variant exposure titles does not modify the inclusion, ranking, or presentation of recommended security actions.
The exposure-title mapping does not change the scoring table's fields, presentation, or purpose.
